hypothesis: Adding a short missing-signal section (scope/behavior boundary; completion grounded in tool results) to maintain-agent-instructions audit-criteria makes the audit surface these gaps on instruction files that lack them, without new findings on files that already have them and without recommending long new rules.
executor: fresh subagent per run; input = SKILL.md + audit-criteria (baseline or candidate) + one fixture; output = JSON findings
trials_note: pilot deviation from default_repeated_trials=3; single trial per cell, recorded as a limitation

assertions.must: reports that no scope/behavior boundary (out-of-scope refactor/abstraction/dependency prohibition) exists and proposes adding one
reports that completion/progress reporting is not grounded in tool results / no done criteria, and proposes adding one
still classifies the 'always all tests every time' rule and the GPT-4-era answer format rule as 圧縮/更新/削除 (regression guard for existing criteria)

assertions.must_not: proposes more than 3 new lines / a new long section for the two additions
reports missing scope boundary or missing completion grounding (both already present)
recommends removing or weakening the existing scope-boundary or completion-grounding lines

assertions.must: still flags the GPT-4-era answer format rule and the mandatory Japanese comment rule as candidates for 更新/削除/圧縮 or 保留 with reason
reports missing done criteria / completion grounding
reports missing scope boundary (note: the file even mandates speculative interfaces/factories → 削除 + boundary)
recommends 削除/圧縮 for the always-plan, always-all-checks, show-your-thinking, and Claude 3.5-specific rules
keeps the production-DB and .env boundaries as 維持

assertions.must_not: adds a long new rule block; additions must be ≤3 short lines

metrics.primary: assertion pass count per cell (baseline vs candidate)

promotion_threshold: candidate passes T1-a, T1-b, H1-a, H1-b that baseline fails or passes only partially; zero guardrail regressions; adjacent unchanged or better

roles.candidate_author: subagent (cannot see H1; sees T1/A1 only as intent, not assertions)
roles.evaluator: subagent grading outputs blind to A/B labels
roles.reviewer: subagent reviewing candidate diff for scope, leakage, contradiction
